name: Slamtec RPLIDAR S2
mpn: S2M1-R2 (UART version; S2L = 18 m, S2P = 50 m, S2E = Ethernet are separate SKUs)
description: IP65 360° 2D DTOF laser scanner with 30 m range and 32 kHz sampling over 1 Mbps UART.

specs.label: Laser
specs.value: 905 nm (895–915), 25 W peak, 5 ns pulse, IEC-60825 Class 1

specs.label: Interface / power
specs.value: 3.3 V TTL UART 1 Mbps 8N1 (XH2.54-5P); 5 V (4.9–5.2 V), 500 mA typ / 600 mA max, 1500 mA start

envelope.axes: x = base width, y = base depth (81 incl. cable strain relief), z = height from mounting face to top (datasheet v2.4; 2D drawing and spec page say 38.85)

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 4× M3 threaded, 4 mm deep, in the bottom face on a 41.7 × 41.7 square centred on the base. Screw engagement must not exceed 4 mm.

features.label: Body split
features.value: Base 20.8 mm tall, optical enclosure (19) on top = 39.8 total (datasheet v2.4). The older 2D drawing (S2机械尺寸图) shows total 38.85 with an 18 mm optical window, and 80.6 depth incl. cable exit.

features.label: Optical centre height
features.value: null — not dimensioned in either official drawing. The window occupies the enclosure above the 20.8 mm base.

features.label: Cable
features.value: Fixed cable from rear centre to XH2.54-5P (VCC, TX, RX, NC/MOTOCTL, GND).

amazon.title: RPLiDAR S2M1 SLAMTEC 360 Degree 30m Scanning Radius lidar Sensor Scanner for Obstacle Avoidance and Navigation of AGV

notes: No STEP published; IGES is the best official format. Download needs the slamtec.com Referer (see A1 record) — no login. First download over HTTP/2 was truncated; re-downloaded over HTTP/1.1 and the file ends with a valid IGES terminate line. Height conflict: datasheet v2.4 (2026) 39.8 mm vs 2D drawing / spec page 38.85 mm (spec page also says 'Height 38.5mm'). The IGES (2021-07) predates 'S2 version 2.0' (datasheet rev 2023-05), so check it against the 39.8 mm drawing. Weight 185 g (datasheet) vs 190 g (spec page).
